claim: *In-flight ownership model.* A current claim records owner, epoch, and lifetime. Completion releases the claim; expiry makes it reclaimable. The model distinguishes a live claim from a stale one without representing the storage machinery that implements the lease.

topology.description: Claimed lease completes or expires; expired lease can be reclaimed by another actor.

required_terms: A live claim is distinguishable from a stale one.
bw_encoding: Grayscale publication candidate. Restored dashed expiry and reclaim paths versus solid completion. Gray separates active, cleanly released and stale states.
redesign: Restored dashed expiry and reclaim paths versus solid completion. Gray separates active, cleanly released and stale states.
alt: Claim opens CLAIMED with owner, epoch and expires_at. Completion leads to RELEASED; expiry leads to RECLAIMABLE. A return transition allows another actor to claim again. The state model distinguishes live and stale claims without showing the storage implementation. Gray fills distinguish the source semantic roles; labels and line conventions retain their meanings.
